verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero can to an illegible orange sliver beside microscopic subtitle text, and the Shop Now pill overlaps the circle and almost touches the right edge; an empty starfield block sits on the left. B keeps a recognisable (if tiny) can, a readable subtitle and a well-sized headline, but the logo is crammed into the circle above a CTA that spills past it, the can floats away from its glow circle, and the left panel is dead space.

A has a clean left text stack (logo, headline, subtitle), but there's no space between headline and subtitle, a large empty starfield square sits in the middle, the can is tiny and cut off from its circle, and the CTA overlaps the circle edge. B (same as the earlier A) reduces the product to an unreadable orange stub, makes the subtitle illegible and pushes the CTA past the circle against the right edge.

A reads well left to right: headline, subtitle and CTA in order, and the can sits properly inside its glow circle. Flaws: the SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny and garbled, the subtitle crowds the headline, and the middle starfield panel is empty filler. B destroys the can (an illegible orange sliver), shrinks the subtitle to microscopic size and has the CTA overlapping and overrunning the circle.
